notes.title: Creator Homepage
notes.content:
Hello,

today i have something that is not a bugfix.


Valve created a "Hub" that is known as "Creator Homepage", which puts all Games related to a certain creator/publisher in one place.

Features (i have noticed so far, still in Beta.):

- All games in one place
- All sales listed
- upcoming games are listed too
- You can "Follow" to get notified about things like sales, new releases etc.
- Forum that is not specific to a single game
- Social Media integration

==========

Link: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/yaekogames
(also accessible from the store page, just click on the name on the right side)

I think that this is a good thing since it allows people to not "miss" something new.
In the past i had multiple people coming up to me, and telling me: "I didnt even knew there were 2 new games, why didnt you tell me?" (despite the fact that there were announcements on steam about it etc.)

Unlike social media, this page is integrated into steam and does not need a seperate account to use. (or for me, 20 different social media accounts... and you still cant reach the people that dont have social media -.-)

It is currently in Beta and things probably will change/get enhanced, but you can give it a try if you are interested.

notes.title: Releasedate changed [Now April 9th]
notes.content:
Hello,

i am sorry that i have to tell you that i had to move the Release Date back a week.

The Reasons for this are:

- I lost a lot of time when the games Physics decided to go "funny" (this happened multiple times, i probably lost a week or so due to this.)
- I dont want to have the same situation as with ReThink Evolved where parts of the game are "unpolished" or simply "cheap".
- I want to "polish" the game a bit more
- I am not satisfied with a lot of the later puzzles.
- There still is one (very rare) bug that has to do something with physics, which i could not yet fix (i cant even properly track it down because it is so rare and not replicable)
- Proper english translation got delayed (my english is "weird" :P)

[b]There is *nothing* wrong with the game[/b].

I worked really hard over the last days (soemthing around 16 hours a day) to somehow manage a Release today, and technically i could release the game as it is (its fully functional and playable), but it does not meet my own quality standards.

I know that it is bad to have to wait for another week, because some people already told me that they were waiting, but this is in your best interest.

We are currently playtesting the game with three people to ensure a stable and bug free experience on release-day.

=======================

A few Screenshots of the game as it currently is, showing things that i have not shown before because they were extremely unfinished:

[b]Please note that these Screenshots show an unfinished game and do contain visual "glitches" (thats why i need more time :P, i dont want this in my games anymore.)[/b]


Besides the Green, Blue and Orange there is a 4th area, the pruple one, which will contain the most difficult puzzles of the game. (unless i add more during the next week :P):
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/ccfd8e00556edb7a7d0bdc0adb1ecbdc5c4b4055.jpg[/img]


The game will tell its background/narative with these panels that you can see on the right, and there is a bunch of them in the game. (There are also other things, but i will keep them hidden until release.)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/f4bf17b0ee4305a56ed7c29620e825e18442466c.jpg[/img]


I also changed the Tutorials, they do now have a small video to underline the explanation. (The game only explains the controls, everything else is the players job.) [The video there is a placeholder and has already been replaced]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/48fa728e845c98b0d89e39109dcb8497ab81da37.jpg[/img]


I show you these work in progress screenshots to underline what i said above, that my goal is to deliver the best "ReThink" so far instead of meeting some randomly set release date.

Again, i am sorry, but it has to be.

Thank you.

notes.title: More Screenshots
notes.content:
Hello,

I am still working on a lot of things, but i made a few more screenshots to share.


All Screenshots show the game as it currently is.


This is a part of one of the earlier Puzzles, obviously unsolved.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/e3d3431a20ea3c4319d31686ee706358378d3786.jpg[/img]


This is #25 after i changed it, an older Screenshot can be found on the Store Page (I will replace them before release.)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/ced5c2386bf27ffb5552d8fab916b4d52097799c.jpg[/img]


And an unusual Screenshot, focused on stuff that is not related to any Puzzle.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/58cabfb2aca6c68b5267209cc79b31e81af291fe.jpg[/img]


I am still working on a variety of things because the games physics decided that it would be a great idea if cubes would fly around after loading, which i (obviously) did not found very funny, not at all.

After a lenghty "discussion" about "why cubes should not fly around at near light speed after loading" the game decided that it would be better to behave. (after i forced it to behave properly :P)


EMAILS:
If you sent me a mail within the last days, or the upcoming days until release, i have not, and will not answer because i have no time to deal with this now. (I will care about the mails on release - thank you for your patience.)

I still want to release the game on April 2nd, despite the time i lost because of that phyiscs issue, but this requires a lot of overtime work.

TL:DR If i dont reply it doesn't mean i am ignoring you.

notes.title: Three additional Screenshots
notes.content:
Hello,

i decided to show off a bit more from the game, in the state it currently is. (Still Work in Progress)

This Screenshot shows the first Puzzle/Room you will encounter.
There is another Puzzle locatad on top of it, and you can look from one room into the other.
If you were in the Puzzle above, you could see this Puzzle as you left it behind. (solved, everything is where you have put it)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/8c047bd439b7bf44341aa1361826d4c80908fb05.jpg[/img]

This one is an overview of multiple Puzzles.
Some of these Puzzles intersect others, and you can always see previously solved Puzzles, and currently unsolved ones.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/a46db7920b684d447ee96777c03add80e569d8d2.jpg[/img]

Here you can see the End of a Puzzle that contains two other Puzzles within itself. (these two are not visible here, the whole Puzzle is too large to fit onto a single Screenshot)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32376256/3c1494fb701e481f84bf4b7db4328be7c52ea04b.jpg[/img]

I will post new Screenshots every few Days, until release.
Puzzles shown on these Screenshots are subject to change.
The Screenshots show the game as it is at the moment when i post them.


If you have Questions, Feedback etc., feel free to visit the Forums or contact me via twitter: https://twitter.com/YaekoGames
